{{Youmay|Erpham, an Ewok deity|[[Erpham Warrick]]}}
'''Erpham''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] nature spirit that came every century to battle the [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]]. "Erpham" was also a popular name for male Ewoks.
